# SCI-MAP v0.1 r0.4-to-r0.5 Semantic Change Map

Status: bounded change-control record; stable IDs preserved

## Inventory Invariant

- Requirements remain `SCI-MAP-REQ-001--052`, exactly 52.
- Predictions remain `SCI-MAP-PRED-001--025`, exactly 25.
- No stable requirement or prediction ID was renumbered.

## Equation Changes

| Area | r0.5 change |
| --- | --- |
| Signal/map notation | `x_i` becomes `z_i=Z_i^PTC`; map becomes `mhat_p`. Paired `x/r` remain KID coordinates. |
| Contribution set | The compressed PTC-available/MAP-admit Boolean becomes ten typed gates with pre-arithmetic screening and cause/scope preservation. |
| Coefficient | `omega_i` becomes exact PTC MAP-facing `gamma_i`; no family is selected, so the numerical route is unavailable. |
| Response/bias | Undefined `mu_0` is removed. The authoritative statement is conditional perturbation response; PTC lambda, removed components, null states, and bias are separate. |
| Covariance | Map covariance is `C_m,out`; unknown/incomplete terms retain typed state. |
| Coadd | `u_op=1` is defined by an exact uniform dimensionless family; stacked signal, `B_out`, `T_obs`, `C_obs` and blocks are typed. |
